mapper.select: SELECT vdate, mdate, payDate, payStatus, finprodId FROM ( SELECT FIN_CASH_PLAN.VDATE AS vdate, FIN_CASH_PLAN.MDATE AS mdate, FIN_CASH_PLAN.PAY_DATE AS payDate, '已付息' AS payStatus, FIN_CASH_PLAN.FINPROD_ID AS finprodId FROM FIN_CASH_PLAN WHERE FIN_CASH_PLAN.CASH_ID = #{cashId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL LEFT JOIN PRD_LAYER_PARAM ON TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_ID = PRD_LAYER_PARAM.FINPROD_ID WHERE nvl(PRD_LAYER_PARAM.P_FINPROD_ID, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_ID) = FIN_CASH_PLAN.FINPROD_ID AND FIN_CASH_PLAN.MDATE = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.MDATE AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.IS_CANCEL = #{no,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.Trade_Status = #{tradeStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.PS in (#{ps,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{ps2,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{ps3,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{ps4,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) ) UNION ALL SELECT FIN_CASH_PLAN.VDATE AS vdate, FIN_CASH_PLAN.MDATE AS mdate, FIN_CASH_PLAN.PAY_DATE AS payDate, '未付息' AS payStatus, FIN_CASH_PLAN.FINPROD_ID AS finprodId FROM FIN_CASH_PLAN WHERE FIN_CASH_PLAN.CASH_ID = #{cashId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL LEFT JOIN PRD_LAYER_PARAM ON TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_ID = PRD_LAYER_PARAM.FINPROD_ID WHERE nvl(PRD_LAYER_PARAM.P_FINPROD_ID, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_ID) = FIN_CASH_PLAN.FINPROD_ID AND FIN_CASH_PLAN.MDATE = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.MDATE AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.IS_CANCEL = #{no,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.Trade_Status = #{tradeStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.PS in (#{ps,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{ps2,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{ps3,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{ps4,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) ) ) order by mdate asc
select FIN_PRODUCT.VDATE, FIN_PRODUCT.MDATE from FIN_PRODUCT where FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select CASH_ID CASH_ID, MDATE MDATE, CASH_NUM CASH_NUM, CASH_TYPE CASH_TYPE, VDATE_UNADJUST VDATE_UNADJUST, MDATE_UNADJUST MDATE_UNADJUST, PAY_DATE_UNADJUST PAY_DATE_UNADJUST, VDATE VDATE, PAY_DATE PAY_DATE, TERMDAYS TERMDAYS, VDATE_Y VDATE_Y, VDATE_TERM VDATE_TERM, MDATE_TERM MDATE_TERM, TERMDAYS_TERM TERMDAYS_TERM, PRIN_AMT PRIN_AMT, INT_PRIN_AMT INT_PRIN_AMT, INT_AMT INT_AMT, IS_PAY_INT IS_PAY_INT, CASH_AMT CASH_AMT, CASH_BASEAMT CASH_BASEAMT, CASH_UNIT_TYPE CASH_UNIT_TYPE, CALC_FUNCTION CALC_FUNCTION, FREQUENCY FREQUENCY, FINPROD_ID FINPROD_ID, FINPROD_TYPE FINPROD_TYPE, FINPROD_TYPE2 FINPROD_TYPE2, BRANCH BRANCH, PAY_TYPE PAY_TYPE, CREATE_USER CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME UPDATE_TIME from FIN_CASH_PLAN where CASH_ID = #{cashId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
select IS_SUS from FIN_PRODUCT where FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
